title: b7z9.50b: wire sanitizers.conf into native_sim test builds (EXTRA_CONF_FILE or included prj.conf)
description: Child of b7z9.50 (R-APPC-009): lichen/tests/sanitizers.conf (CONFIG_ASAN=y CONFIG_UBSAN=y) is referenced by nothing. Wire it into the native_sim test builds — either per-test prj.conf include or the CI invocation's EXTRA_CONF_FILE — and verify one native_sim build actually compiles with sanitizers on heft. Lands after b7z9.50a or independently.
